kids: Share your wish list with Santa
breakfast-with-santa-at-outlets-at-castl.source: Outlets at Castle Rock event page
about: Breakfast with Santa is a holiday morning at the Outlets at Castle Rock.
It takes place Saturday, December 5, 2026 from 9:30 to 11 AM.
The location is Suite 350 at 5050 Factory Shops Blvd, between HEYDUDE and Rally House.
A pancake breakfast with Santa is served.
Cost is $5 per person for guests over age 3.
Guests can bring a new, unwrapped toy instead of paying.
Toys support Cancer Fighters to the Rescue and Children's Hospital Colorado.
Kids can take photos with Santa and share wish lists.
Mrs. Claus leads a storytime.
Holiday characters stop by for meet and greets.
An RSVP is requested through Eventbrite.
Outlets at Castle Rock also hosts a separate sensory friendly Santa event.
faq: When is Breakfast with Santa at Outlets at Castle Rock?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 9:30 to 11 AM.
Where is it?
Suite 350, 5050 Factory Shops Blvd, Castle Rock, CO 80108.
How much does it cost?
$5 per person, or bring a new unwrapped toy. The price applies to guests over age 3.
Where do the toys go?
They support Cancer Fighters to the Rescue and kids at Children's Hospital Colorado.
Is there a photo with Santa?
Yes, photo opportunities with Santa are part of the morning.
Is there a story time?
Yes, Mrs. Claus reads a story.
Should I RSVP?
Yes, reserve a spot through the Eventbrite page.

Check the registration page for the current price.
Hyland Hills Park and Recreation District runs the event.

kids: Meet a different Santa every weekend
about: Stanley Marketplace in Aurora hosts free Santa visits.
Visits run weekends from November 28 to December 20, 2026.
Each visit is from 11 AM to 1 PM.
Santa waits at the southeast entrance near Denver Biscuit Company.
A photographer is on site and photos are included.
No reservation or ticket is needed.
Sensory Santa visits Saturday, November 28 at Psychology at Stanley.
Santa en Espanol visits December 12 and ASL Santa visits December 13.
Black Santa visits December 19.
Santa Paws for dogs is December 5 at Stanley Beer Hall.
Kids can follow Stanley Bear's Scavenger Hunt through 10 stops.
Parking is free in lots on the north, east and south sides.
faq: When can kids see Santa at Stanley Marketplace?
Saturdays and Sundays from November 28 to December 20, 2026, 11 AM to 1 PM.
Is it free?
Yes, visits and photos are free.
Do we need a reservation?
No, visits are walk up.
Where is Santa?
At the southeast entrance near Denver Biscuit Company.
Is there a sensory friendly Santa?
Yes, Saturday, November 28 from 11 AM to 1 PM at Psychology at Stanley.
Can dogs meet Santa?
Yes, Santa Paws is Saturday, December 5 from 11 AM to 2 PM at Stanley Beer Hall.
Where do we park?
Free lots on the north, east and south sides, with the southeast lot closest to Santa.

about: Santa Claus visits Edgewater Public Market on four Saturdays.
Dates are November 28 and December 5, 12 and 19, 2026.
Each visit runs 11 AM to 2 PM.
The market is just west of Sloan's Lake.
Visits are free for kids and adults.
Reservations are not required.
A reservation link for set times is planned.
Santa sits inside the market hall.
Look for the Shops This Way sign across from Happy Cones.
Santa sometimes sits near Ink Den Tattoo Studio and Barquentine Brewing Co.
Pets are not allowed inside the market hall.
The visit is an annual tradition at the market.
faq: When is Santa at Edgewater Public Market?
Saturdays November 28 and December 5, 12 and 19, 2026, from 11 AM to 2 PM.
Is it free?
Yes, visits are free.
Do I need a reservation?
No, reservations are not required.
Where is Santa inside the market?
Usually in front of the Shops This Way sign across from Happy Cones.
